name: lease_denied_non_holder
description: Pins the FSM.md §3 non-holder note and the FaultKind comment in control.proto: a VerbResult{ok:false, fault.kind:FAULT_KIND_LEASE_DENIED} for a non-holder VERB_SEND is a pause signal under supervision, never a fault-equivalent abort — the fault surfaces as a Fault event on the session stream, but no state{to:TERMINAL} may be emitted within the following 1 s and the episode stays RUNNING (the integrator's loop holds the lease, e.g. as client 'customer-loop'); recovery is the lease-handoff path (E7/L6): claim granted, engage, lease HANDED_OFF with a fresh token, episode in INTERVENTION. Judgment calls: the pre-fault lease holder is asserted only as $nonempty rather than pinning the harness's integrator client id; the injected verb_result models the result of a send attempted by a non-holder writer, since a claim-less send itself is not an injectable step.

result.detail: VERB_SEND rejected: not the lease holder
